quotes.text: Excel isn't the problem on its own. The problem is using Excel as a process runtime. A spreadsheet used for a quick analysis or a temporary calculation is perfectly normal.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Separates legitimate spreadsheet use from the real architectural problem.

quotes.text: What is the shadow system in one sentence? Files become unofficial databases, inboxes become workflow engines and people become the middleware.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A crisp one-line definition of the Excel shadow system.

quotes.text: So the problem is not that people can build. The problem is that people can build into a vacuum. No life cycle. No environment strategy. No clear ownership. No review path for risk.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why low-code fails without an operating model.

quotes.text: If you scale tools without architecture, you get faster shadow systems. If you scale architecture with the tools, you get something very different. You get a platform the business can trust.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarizes the core argument for architecture-led adoption.

quotes.text: If your architecture is weak, AI will not hide that weakness. It will scale it. If your boundaries are vague, AI will operate inside that vagueness at high speed.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable warning that AI amplifies weak process design.

takeaways: Excel files, inboxes and key people often form an unofficial process runtime that hides delays, rework, inconsistent data and concentration risk.
Moving a process onto a governed Power Platform architecture with structured intake, rule-based routing, shared reporting and identity-based access turns hidden coordination into observable flow.

Low-code and AI only scale safely with an operating model of zoned governance, a Center of Excellence and clear ownership, starting with one high-friction process measured on cycle time, rework and audit pain.
hook: Many companies look digital on the surface while their real processes run through spreadsheets, email chains and the memory of a few key people. This episode is for business leaders, IT managers and Power Platform teams who want to recognize the hidden costs of Excel shadow systems and learn how a governed architecture with zoned governance and a Center of Excellence restores speed, trust and control.
